transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came because it’s gotten to where I know my in-laws aren’t just having little arguments with me, you know? They’re using the altar, and the parish committee too, to push me out. And everyone acts like I’m making too much of it, but I’ve done so much for this family—years and years—and now it’s like they’re trying to make everybody forget that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

Yes… not all the time, but on a few nights I heard my mother’s voice. She’s been gone a long time, but it sounded like her telling me where to put the marigolds and the candles. And I know people think that sounds strange, but my mother always knew how things should be arranged, especially for church things and family gatherings.

And once I saw her by the kitchen doorway. Just standing there. My husband said nobody was there, but I saw her.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high or energetic for days at a time?

Yes, there were days like that… I felt so bright, like everything was clear and I knew exactly what needed to be done. And then if someone questioned me about the altar—my sister-in-law especially, always with that look—I’d just snap. It felt like they weren’t just asking about flowers or candles, they were insulting my whole family, my mother, everything we stood for.
During those bright, energetic periods, did you need much less sleep than usual?

Yes… at first I really didn’t need much. I’d sleep maybe a couple of hours and then be up again, making lists, thinking of what had to be done, where things should go, who needed to be called. It felt important, like if I didn’t write it down right then it would all get twisted around.

Now it’s different, though. I’m awake before dawn a lot, but not in that clear way. I just lie there worrying, and then when morning comes I don’t feel rested at all.
When you heard or saw your mother, was that during one of those bright, energetic periods?

Yes… yes, I think it was. It was all during that time when I wasn’t really sleeping, just a couple hours here and there, and I was rushing around like everything depended on me fixing the altar just right.

I felt so sure it was my job, like a special duty. And that’s when I heard my mother, and when I thought I saw her there. Later, when I came down from that… I still felt awful, guilty and sad about all of it, but I wasn’t hearing her voice or seeing her anymore.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things when you were not in one of those unusually high, energetic periods or feeling very down?

No… I don’t think so. The voices, seeing my mother, that was only during that stretch when I wasn’t sleeping hardly at all and I was running around, so sure I had to fix the altar the right way.

After my mood dropped, I still felt terrible about it—guilty, sad, going over things in my head—but I wasn’t hearing her or seeing her then. It was just… the heaviness, not that.
